name: bubbles-atomic-live-reconfiguration
instr:
Bubbles cannot reconfigure active models without replacement or loss of unrelated live state. Add ordered, atomic configuration transactions across unlike components, leaving construction, update, and rendering unchanged when unused.

Expose `reconfigure.Change`, `reconfigure.Apply`, and `reconfigure.ApplyError` publicly from `charm.land/bubbles/v2/reconfigure`. Prepared changes are single-use. Successful transactions expose all configuration together. Rejection restores every participant, identifies the zero-based index and stable package-qualified label, preserves the underlying error for standard inspection, and allows a corrected new transaction. Consumed changes cannot be reused.

Validate every cadence, interval, spring, frame, and geometry candidate before observable mutation. Preserve animation progress, running and focus state, and issued-message ownership. Reconcile unreachable paginator pages and changed filepicker constraints deterministically, preserving valid navigation and every directory entry. Retain the current selection when it remains an eligible visible entry.

Help and viewport changes preserve bindings, width, ShowAll, caller-owned content, highlights, and valid offsets, clamping only when geometry requires it. Textinput and textarea changes preserve editing, validation, suggestions, focus, text, and selection while reconciling owned cursors and rebuilding wrapping and viewport geometry.
